confusion: ❌ 'A plane equation only needs the normal vector' ✅ A plane requires *both* a normal vector (direction) *and* at least one point it passes through.
❌ 'The coefficients A, B, C in Ax + By + Cz + D = 0 are arbitrary' ✅ The coefficients (A, B, C) represent the components of the normal vector to the plane.
❌ 'Two planes are always parallel if their normal vectors are different' ✅ Two planes are parallel if their normal vectors are *proportional* (not necessarily equal).
